column3: BSB adds “who teach” and renders “greater judgment” as “judged more strictly.”
BSB follows the critical text with “When” (Εἰ); the Textus Receptus reads “Behold.” “The whole animal” renders “their whole body.”
BSB follows the critical text with “how small a spark” (ἡλίκον); the Textus Receptus reads “a little fire.”
BSB follows the critical text without the Textus Receptus “so”; “the whole person” renders “the whole body.”
BSB follows the critical text with “restless”; the Textus Receptus reads “uncontrollable.”
BSB follows the critical text with “Lord” (κύριον); the Textus Receptus reads “God.” “Our” is added.
BSB follows the critical text with “Neither can a salt spring produce fresh water”; the Textus Receptus reads “So no spring yields both salt and fresh water.”
BSB renders “lie against the truth” as “deny the truth.”
BSB restructures the verse: “Peacemakers who sow in peace reap the fruit of righteousness.”
